notes.title: 🎃✨ Magical Mischief Awaits: Unveiling 'Myrcella the Meandering Mage' this Halloween! ✨🎃
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44530176/7fdeb86e5f1b41271093a2af63c0fb573e2b8b9d.png[/img]

Happy Halloween to all our Steam Community! 🎃 We are thrilled to announce the release of our newest game, "Myrcella the Meandering Mage". Dive into a comedic fantasy adventure with Myrcella as she explores the beautiful Kingdom of Falkenhorn, solves whimsical problems with her magic, and finds romance along the way! Be enchanted by the captivating storyline, charming characters, and delightful anime art. Our Halloween treat for you is this magical journey filled with laughter and love. Discover the charming and comedic storyline now on Steam! 🎮🧙‍♀️

Check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2639580/Myrcella_the_Meandering_Mage/

[h1]
Get Massive savings by buying the Myrcella the Meandering Mage Gourmet Grimoire bundle with OST and Yummy Recipes from our cookbook[/h1]

Please join our group and curator page for cool competitions, news, and gossip.
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/MEWGAMES/
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/mew-games/

Enjoy the magic,
The Mew Games Team
